name: ppgp
description: Portable continuity and coordination protocol for long-running coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent goal continuity and coordination for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use PPGP to preserve verified goal state and coordinate optional concurrent workstreams, scoped waits, leases, checkout ownership, recovery evidence, and the next executable action across long sessions, context compaction, and agent handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Recover the current PPGP state and continue from the next safe executable action.
